reviews.title: Solid case for the money
reviews.comment: The case has plenty of room for radiators and fans of various sizes. The metal they used is on the thin side so dont over torque any fastener or it will warp or contort the case. The rear panel design could've been a little better, there isn't much room to cable manage.

reviews.title: Solid Case for Budget to Mid-End PC Builds
reviews.comment:
Great case for the budget to mid-end PC builds.
I used this case for my first ever build a few months ago and I have no complaints. Good airflow, the 4 included PWM fans are quiet and daisy-chained, and overall was simple to build with.
Only caveat is not a ton of space in the back for cable management, but there are ample openings to route the cables and with a few zip ties and simple managing the back closes fine. But would recommend a fully modular PSU.
Overall, I am a big fan of this case for the price and recommend it for any budget PC build that is going for a simple and clean aesthetic.
